claims.source_quote_ar: مَنْ: نَكِرَةٌ مَوْصُوفَةٌ مُبْتَدَأٌ، وَمَا قَبْلَهَا الْخَبَرُ.
claims.claim_ar: «مَنْ» اسم نكرة موصوفة ويعمل مبتدأً، وما قبلها خبر.
claims.claim_en: The word 'مَنْ' is an indefinite (nominative) described noun functioning as a mubtada' (subject), and what precedes it is the predicate (khabar).
claims.needs_review_reason: al-Tibyan gives a general rule that 'مَنْ' can be a نَكِرَةٌ مَوْصُوفَةٌ functioning as مبتدأ; in S16:2 'مَنْ' occurs in the phrase 'على مَنْ يَشَاءُ' after the preposition عَلَى, so its syntactic role (whether treated as مبتدأ for a preceding خبر or as a مجرور مرتبط بعَلَى) should be re-evaluated in context.

claims.source_quote_ar: يَجُوزُ أَنْ تَكُونَ «أَنْ» بِمَعْنَى أَيْ. وَأَنْ تَكُونَ مَصْدَرِيَّةً.

claims.claim_en: The particle 'أَنْ' may be used with the meaning 'أي' (i.e.) or may be masdariyya (infinitival/nominalizing) depending on context.
